steps.title: dp3 dies
steps.internal: dp3's engine process exits while its API server stays alive. The cached status can remain healthy; /health returns 503. The survivors detect the fault and report unhealthy.

steps.title: IRO saves the reconfig, then sends it
steps.note: After at least two poll intervals in recovering, IRO saves the reconfig before sending it.
steps.internal: Each survivor queues the same request_id. Progress on later observations determines whether the reconfig finishes.

steps.note: vLLM cannot add a rank to a running group, so pod-3 is left as it is. The group serves with 3 until the next group; with --ft-capacity-restore=reset-all IRO resets the group instead.
